html:
Claude Code Pro Limit Hit – How to Keep Working

You can keep Claude Code running when the Pro limit is hit by using tokentrim. It trims tool output and summarizes earlier conversation, allowing you to continue without waiting for a new quota. tokentrim has been tested on 135 real conversations and cut history re-read by 75% and made limits last 4.0x longer.

What happens when your Claude Code Pro limit is reached

  1. Install tokentrim (plugin or full git clone).
  2. Run the replay command – it shows your current usage numbers.
  3. tokentrim’s “compaction window” summarizes past dialogue, cutting re‑read history by about 75% and extending limits up to 4.0× longer.
  4. The trimmed output is spooled to disk, so the next request stays under the Pro limit.

What you get and the cost

  • Free tier: all hooks, three strength profiles, replay command, local dashboard, daily‑budget guard, cold‑cache alert. Nothing leaves your machine.
  • Pro lifetime: $49 one‑time (first 500 buyers). Adds a hosted dashboard you can open on any device, a Monday digest, weekly budget alerts at 80%, Slack totals, and support for up to three machines.
  • Pro monthly: $9 per month, same Pro features as the lifetime license.

All features run on Python 3.9 or newer (macOS or Linux).

FAQ

Why does my Pro plan still hit the limit? Even with a Pro plan Claude Code can exceed the per‑request token ceiling. tokentrim reduces the amount sent by summarizing earlier conversation and trimming tool output, which historically cut history re‑read by 75% and saved 55-70% of billed cost.

Do I need to send any data to the cloud? No. By default nothing leaves your machine. The hosted dashboard in the Pro tier is optional.

Can I see how much I’m saving? Run the replay command; it prints your own usage numbers and shows the reduction achieved by tokentrim.

Next, get started with tokentrim to keep your Claude Code Pro running smoothly.
